feeds.title: Denver Regenerative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: At Denver Regenerative Medicine, we're an early pioneer in offering stem cell therapy treatments in Denver as alternatives to conventional intervention techniques. Our new procedure involves the use of both adipose (body-fat) and bone marrow-derived stem cells. Explore our blog for industry news and new research about stem cell treatments and more.

feeds.title: Restorative Physical Medicine Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in the diagnosis and treatment of pain and spine disorders as well as sports medicine. specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of spine disorders as well as pain management and sports medicine. Our goal at RPM is to enhance and restore function and movement. We are excited to bring you the latest information about research and advancements in pain management. The blog will also be used to post updates about our practice and keep in touch with our patients.

feeds.title: The Fraum Center
feeds.description: The Fraum Center for Restorative Health opened in 1991, with the goal of helping patients live pain-free. We continue to focus on that by implementing the newest therapies, so our patients achieve the best outcomes. Our highly trained team provides a personal and comprehensive level of care offering Prenatal Chiropractic, Sports Chiropractic, Restorative Medicine, and Nutritional Therapies. We also offer our patients nutritional counseling, sports and athletic training performance maintenance, and personalized plans for lifestyle modifications.

feeds.title: K2 Restorative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: K2 Restorative Medicine creates a state-of-the-art treatment plan to help you reach your goals for youthful beauty and whole-body wellness. We appreciate your natural beauty and create options that will enhance your appearance without compromising your own, natural look. Our blog section focuses on sharing info about solutions offered at K2-Restorative Medicine.

feeds.title: Institute for Stem Cell & Regenerative Medicine News
feeds.description: The Institute for Stem Cell and Regenerative Medicine (ISCRM) is a center of discovery linking a pioneering past to a future of profound possibilities. Our mission is to turn fundamental discoveries in stem cell science into therapies for today's patients. The Institute for Stem Cell and Regenerative Medicine plays an integral part in, developing the human body's astonishing power to heal itself.

feeds.title: Regenerate Health Medical Center Blog
feeds.description: Regenerate Health Medical Center was founded in 2015 with a vision to provide the care Dr. ACE always wished she could find - care that gets to the root of problems and creates lasting improvements that allow individuals the freedom to live their lives with joy, feeling empowered with their health, rather than as a victim. Regenerate Health Medical Center specializes in natural and non-invasive treatments to help you increase your performance, health, and wellbeing.

feeds.title: Michigan Center For Regenerative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: The Michigan Center for Regenerative Medicine specializes in clinically proven Regenerative Medicine from local experts who are Board-certified physicians. Educate and discover the many benefits of regenerative medicine in Michigan through a variety of blog topics and news events that may help and apply to your overall health.

feeds.title: Restorative Health Blog
feeds.description: Restorative Health offers an expertise in hormone replacement therapy for men and women. Thay are passionate about restoring health and vitality to women and men through modern cutting age treatments and therapies. Stay up to date on the latest news in health and age management practices. They cover the latest stories from research and development to staying informed on the latest diseases and treatments.

feeds.title: Greenberg Regenerative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Greenberg Regenerative Medicine, by Scott Greenberg, MD specializes in holistic and comprehensive approaches to sports medicine, regenerative orthopedics, chronic pain, arthritis, and post-concussion syndrome. Greenberg Regenerative Medicine Blog provides resources on key concepts and the latest advances in Regenerative Medicine.

feeds.title: QC Kinetix Blog
feeds.description: QC Kinetix is a Regenerative Medicine Pain Clinic that offers various non-surgical pain management therapies to help patients who are dealing with all types of conditions. Our regenerative medicine blog provides news about treatments and trends in non-surgical regenerative medicine. Learn more about our regenerative orthopedics clinics and pain doctors.

feeds.title: Sklar Center for Restorative Medicine Blog
feeds.description: Susan Sklar, MD founded the Sklar Center for Restorative Medicine to meet the needs of people who are looking for a natural approach to health care. At the Sklar Center, we help our patients achieve health by finding and treating the underlying causes of disease. Explore the blog to learn more about your health and well-being by reading through the selection of articles by Dr. Susan E. Sklar

feeds.title: RegMedNet
feeds.description: RegMedNet is a community site that unites the diverse regenerative medicine and advanced therapies community. Through a partnership with our sister journal, Regenerative Medicine, we seek to educate and inspire to help this exciting field move forward at an even faster rate. Through the blog, we are bringing you the latest news and views in regenerative medicine and cell therapy,

feeds.title: Center for Regenerative Biotherapeutics
feeds.description: At Mayo Clinic, unhurried, comprehensive evaluations offer the best chance of healing and getting back to your life. Mayo Clinic experts solve the world's toughest medical problems - one patient at a time. No matter what serious, complex, or rare health challenge you're facing, you can be confident that Mayo Clinic has extensive experience in treating patients with your specific condition. The blog will provide you with the latest news and highlights from Mayo Clinic's Center for Regenerative Biotherapeutics.
